content.title: Netflix US on Instagram: "NOAH KAHAN: OUT OF BODY is now playing!"
content.text: NOAH KAHAN: OUT OF BODY is now playing!Man this guy is something special. Keep sharing ; you are a gift.I’ll never lose interest ♥️I laughed and cried,it's amazingI wont ever lose interest in the person that like saved a lot of people@noahkahanmusic, thank you for championing mental health by talking about it and sharing your own experience. You are on your path pursuing your purpose. ❤️❤️❤️🙏🙏🙏😊😊😊You may fall from time to time, and we will sit with you until you choose to get back up, but you will never fail or be stale. 💛 It’s beautiful and inspiring to watch you keep making your way back home to your heart.Beautiful 💛 thank you 🙏Your music has changed people. Your words, your songs, your perspective (see what I did there) is important and has impacted people. You are perfectly you and because you are you are here. Thank you for sharing this glimpse into you, your world, your journey, it made even more of an impact.Bro, your documentary was absolute perfection! 🥹🥹 You've got nothing to be insecure about - you're stunning inside and out! Love your music!!! It resonates with our deepest highs and lows 🫶🏻Hi Noah! Know you’ll probably never see this but my boyfriend is from east Barnard Vermont and your documentary meant so much to us as people that no longer live in Vermont. We would love to have you to our wedding celebration there in September if you would love to join. 🥲Thank U Noah, lov u, u r THE guyI’m a 58 year music loving woman . Obsessed with Noah Kahan and his music. Seriously the world needs someone who is honest with his heart. Always be true to who you are. Life is beautiful imperfections.You don’t always have to fail ya know. Sometimes you’re just great and others can’t handle it.Maybe a weird perspective but would it be so bad? To have a moment in the sun make the money set it up so you will be comfortable if you fall off tomorrow. Have your family and a bit of privacy back? Up or down seems okay to me.I have 3 things to say:1) thank you for being real about your struggles with body image and mental health, there is always someone out there who is feeling the same thing you are and you are not alone in it- even if you’re a now a star 2) thank you for making music that vocalizes my homesickness for Vermont, it helps me cope as a fellow Vermonter living in the south 3) my daughter knows all the words to stick season because she has been listening to it HER WHOLE LIFE. She is 3.5 now.
